subject: english
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

'The team worked extremely efficient under pressure'.
solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. efficient .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error in the sentence lies in the use of the word **"efficient"**.
 
• The word **"efficient"** is an adjective, but the sentence requires an adverb to modify the verb **"worked"**.
 
• The correct adverb form of **"efficient"** is **"efficiently"**.

Correct sentence: *The team worked extremely **efficiently** under pressure*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Adverbs vs. Adjectives:**

 
 
• **Adjectives:** Modify nouns or pronouns (e.g., efficient team).
 
• **Adverbs:** Modify verbs, adjectives, or other adverbs (e.g., worked efficiently).
 
• To correct grammatical errors, always ensure the modifier matches the word it describes.
